description.narrative: EXTENSION OF THE INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING - PHASE IV and PHASE V The main objective of institutional strengthening in eligible countries should be to provide a national institutional mechanism for co-ordinating within these countries national and international efforts for the protection of the ozone layer generally and in particular facilitate actions aimed at speedy phase-out of ozone depleting substances in the countries. (source UNEP/OzL.Pro/ExCom/7/20)
